extraction.Name: Emily Colomb
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded March 3, 1918 by McManigal
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged by Emily Colomb to the Royal Union Mutual Life Insurance Company; receipt March 28, 1918, for $2500; mortgage released July 8, 1925. Deed by Emily Colombe dated July 18, 1918, conveyed the land to Emma Colombo for $6600.
extraction.Fee Patent Date: December 29, 1917 (patent issued); signed by allottee February 13, 1918
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612766 issued December 29, 1917; Northeast quarter section 15, township 100, range 77; fee patent signed by allottee February 13, 1918; receipt for patent signed March 28, 1918; mortgage to Royal Union Mutual Life Insurance Company for $2500, released July 8, 1925; conveyance to Emma Colombo for $6600 dated July 18, 1918; document dated 1929.
